name: Spatial real estate pre-listing checklist app (visionOS)

mentions.name: Spatial real estate pre-listing checklist app (visionOS)
mentions.description: A visionOS app that adds a spatial component to real estate pre-listing checklists, tying standard form data to a physical location. Built as a for-fun prototype to demonstrate how helpful spatially anchored form data can be in certain use cases.
mentions.problem: Standard form data is not tied to a physical location, which limits its usefulness in certain use cases.
